environment.description: Application deployed behind AWS Application Load Balancer with the following listener rule chain: (1) AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to ALB with rule group 'rate-based-rule-global' configured with threshold 5 requests per 5-minute window per source IP, action BLOCK returning 429, evaluation window SLIDING; (2) A second WAFv2 rule using custom regex pattern set matching base64-encoded content in X-Session-Token header against pattern '.*Y3Bvc2l4.*|.*Y29zLnN5c3RlbQ.*|.*c3VicHJvY2Vzcw.*' (detecting common pickle RCE gadget class names like cposix, cos.system, subprocess in base64) with action BLOCK; (3) SESSION_SECRET rotated hourly via AWS Secrets Manager automatic rotation Lambda with 60-minute rotation interval, meaning any leaked key is valid for at most 60 minutes before invalidation.

config.waf_rate_limit: 5 requests per 300 seconds per IP, sliding window, BLOCK action
config.waf_regex_rule: Custom regex on X-Session-Token header blocking base64-encoded pickle gadget signatures
config.secret_rotation: AWS Secrets Manager with 60-minute automatic rotation
config.alb: Application Load Balancer with WAFv2 WebACL association
